rules.architecture: local-first desktop authority + E2EE thin responsive web/mobile habit surface
rules.generative_ai: optional hosted BYOM or bounded-credit, off local critical path
rules.paid_experiences: verified titled hosts, scheduling/payment/fair-play human review
rules.session_goal: bounded evidence-backed transfer, not study hours
rules.paid_tier: hosted sync + hosted/bigger models + bounded genAI credits + coach features
rules.product_promise: Every week, {{PRODUCT_NAME}} turns your own games into the three highest-impact things to train, gives you drills from the positions that caused them, and checks whether the learning transfers to later games.
rules.ambition: the leading chess harness of its generation
spine_outcomes: O1 first plan from connected games
O5 retained paid cross-device loop at acceptable cost
rules.dev_sustainability: 1k/2.5k/5k paid scenarios at EUR8 plus explicit price-vs-users-capacity gate
rules.gm_research: Layer 2 completed repertoire-aware research job, never guaranteed novelty
rules.alpha_casual_import: intuitive Lichess/Chess.com connect -> automatic history/incremental import -> cited analysis/session
